titulo.alumno: Contrasting a reality with «どころか»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «どころか» corrects an expectation and presents a reality that is much more different or intense.
texto: The structure can mean "far from" or "not only not..., but also...". Check whether the second part goes beyond or contradicts the first.
改善 する どころか、待ち時間 は 前 より 長く なりました。 (Far from improving, the waiting time became longer than before.)
彼 は 手伝う どころか、問題 を さらに 複雑 に しました。 (Far from helping, he made the problem even more complicated.)

opciones.texto: «どころか» corrects an expectation and presents a reality that is much more different or intense.
opciones.explicacion: That is the meaning of the pattern in these examples.

opciones.explicacion: It doesn't match the use shown.

opciones.texto: the second action was more useful than the first
opciones.explicacion: It doesn't match the use shown.

pregunta.texto: What information does the second sentence give?

The waiting time went down and he solved the problem.
